texts.li: [sickness] {PLACE}, {TALE}, never got over the sickness. Too many houses stand empty, and the ones still lived in have a cough in them. {FACTION} are giving the town up.\n\nTheir families are on the road to {ITEM}. Some of them will stop at the colony's gate on the way.

[hunger] {PLACE}, {TALE}, has eaten its seed grain two years running, and there is nothing left to plant. {FACTION} are giving the town up.\n\nThe carts on the road to {ITEM} are lighter than carts usually are.

[winter] The winter broke {PLACE}, {TALE}. The roofs that fell in under the snow were never put back, and the families who are left have had enough. {FACTION} are giving the town up.\n\nThe road to {ITEM} is full of carts piled with bedding.

[flood] The water came through {PLACE}, {TALE}, and took the low fields and half the houses with it. {FACTION} have decided not to rebuild.\n\nThe road to {ITEM} is busy with carts, and some of them will come this way.
[fire] Since the fire, {PLACE}, {TALE}, has been more ash than town. {FACTION} have given up trying to raise it again.\n\nIts families are on the road to {ITEM}, with whatever the fire left them.

[strife] Trouble on the roads and quarrels at home have worn {PLACE}, {TALE}, down to nothing. {FACTION} are giving the town up.\n\nThe road to {ITEM} is full of carts, and not everyone on it is sure of a welcome there.

[hard] {PLACE}, {TALE}, has had one bad year after another, and nobody there believes the next will be better. {FACTION} are giving the town up.\n\nIts families are on the road to {ITEM}. Some of them will look for something nearer.

summaries.li: When it's over, {PLACE} will be a ruin on the map. Until then its families pass the colony on the road, and what they leave behind is anyone's to take.

texts.li: A family from {PLACE} has stopped at the colony's gate instead of going on to {ITEM}. They have a handcart, a dog and not much else.\n\nThey'd like to stay, if the colony will have them.

[sickness] A family from {PLACE} has stopped at the gate. They are thin and tired but well, and they say so before anyone asks.\n\nThey would rather start again here than in {ITEM}, where they know nobody.
[hunger] A family from {PLACE} has stopped at the gate. The children look at the colony's fields the way other children look at sweets.\n\nThey ask whether the colony would take them in.

li.label: Take them in
li.outcome: The family unloads the handcart. The dog has already found the warmest spot.

li.label: Feed them and send them on
li.outcome: They sleep a night in the lee of the colony's wall and set off for {ITEM} at first light.

li.label: Point them to {ITEM}
li.outcome: The family is pointed down the road to {ITEM}, and goes.

texts.li: The last carts are leaving {PLACE}, and what didn't fit is being left behind: doors, tools, a cooking pot too big to carry. {FACTION} don't much mind who takes the rest.\n\n{A_nameDef} says the colony could fill a few carts of its own. Some of the others would rather not pick over a town that's still warm.

[fire] What the fire left of {PLACE} is being left for good: blackened beams, a forge, stone that will take a new wall. {FACTION} say anyone who wants it can have it.\n\n{A_nameDef} thinks the colony should take its share before someone else does.

li.label: Salvage what's left
li.outcome: The colony's carts come back loaded with what {PLACE} left behind.

li.label: Leave it
li.outcome: The colony leaves {PLACE} alone. Somebody else will take it, or the weather will.

texts.li: The last of {FACTION} left {PLACE} yesterday. The gates stand open, the wells are covered, and the road through the town is already going to grass.\n\nIt is a ruin on the map now. In a year or two, families may come back to the old walls, or newcomers may.
[salvaged] {PLACE} is empty. What the colony carted away is in its stores now, and the rest is the weather's business.\n\nIt is a ruin on the map now, and swallows have moved into the meeting hall.
{PLACE} is mostly empty now, but not all of it. A few families refused to leave, and {FACTION} have stopped trying to make them. The town stays on the map, smaller and quieter than it was.
